name: Johnston Canyon to the Ink Pots
why: On catwalks bolted to the walls of a limestone canyon past the Lower and Upper Falls, then into a meadow of blue-green springs.
book: Paid parking at Johnston Canyon in summer, or Roam Transit route 9 from Banff. Off-trail is forbidden in the canyon.
dangers: Icy catwalks from October to May: microspikes.
Do not leave the trail or climb the barriers: people have fallen.

points.name: Johnston Canyon trailhead
points.note: On the Bow Valley Parkway, 25 km west of Banff.

points.name: Lower Falls
points.note: A fall seen through a short tunnel in the rock.

points.name: Upper Falls
points.note: A 30 m fall over a cliff, with a platform at its foot.

points.name: Ink Pots
points.note: Seven pools of blue-green spring water in a meadow by Johnston Creek.
